out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: the bistro burger, egg your way, bistro breakfast sandwich, and craft your own bowl.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS discussed consumer advisory with CFM. CFM will add a disclosure to the menu.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: HIGH-TEMPERATURE DISHWASHER IS NOT SANITIZING. SURFACE TEMPERATURE OF PLATE SIMULATING DISHWASHER TESTER WAS 153F.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. HIGH-TEMPERATURE DISHWASHER WILL ONLY BE USED TO WASH AND RINSE ALL FOOD CONTACT SURFACES. 3-COMPARTMENT SINK WILL BE USED TO SANITIZE ALL FOOD CONTACT SURFACES.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: THE BISTRO BURGER, EGG YOUR WAY, BISTRO BREAKFAST SANDWICH, AND CRAFT YOUR OWN BOWL.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. PLEASE FORWARD THE UPDATED MENU WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED A CHEMICAL MIXING DISPENSER IS CONNECTED DOWNSTREAM FROM A MOP SINK WITH AN ATMOSPHERIC BREAKER.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS SHARED THE INFORMATION OF APPROVED SPLITTER WITHI CFM AND MAINTENANCE. THE FACILITY WILL NEED TO INSTALL AN APPROVED SPLITTER ON THE MOP SINK WITHIN 3 CALENDAR DAYS.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: SANITIZING STEP OF DISHWASHER WAS NOT VERIFIED. OBSERVED A SANITIZING RINSE CONCENTRATION OF LESS THAN. 50PPM CHLORINE SOLUTION.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. 3-COMPARTMENT SINK WILL BE USED TO SANITIZE ALL FOOD CONTACT SURFACES.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): CUT FRUITS, CHEESES, SLICED HAM, SLICED TURKEY, SLICED PEPPERONI, CUT TOMATO.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EHS AND CFM ESTABLISHED THE “TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL PROCEDURE”.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: SEVERAL SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF OIL AND BUTTER WERE NOT LABELED.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM WILL LABEL THE SQUEEZE BOTTLES PROPERLY.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED FRUIT FLIES IN DRY STORAGE AND MOP SINK AREAS.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT PEST CONTROL SERVICE.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. MILK CRATES WERE USED IN WALK-IN FREEZER AND WALK-IN COOLER TO STORE FOODS.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CFM WILL REMOVE THE MILK CRATES.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CFM RELOCATED THE WET WIPING CLOTHES. COURTYARD BY MARRIOTT TYSONS (Inspection Date: 06/06/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: DISHWASHER IS NOT SANITIZING.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THE DISHWASHER.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Design Features
violations.observation: The backflow or backsiphonage prevention device installed on the mop sink is not identified as meeting standards set by the American Society of Sanitary Engineering. The Y-Splitter installed after the atmospheric vacuum breaker (AVB) creates continuous pressure on the backflow prevention device.
violations.corrective_action: A backflow or back siphonage prevention device installed on a water supply system shall meet American Society of Sanitary Engineering (A.S.S.E.) standards for construction, installation, maintenance, inspection, and testing for that specific application and type of device. At the mop sink, if a splitter valve is used, it must be one that incorporates pressure relief. Alternately, you may install a Water Wasting Tee and then connect the system to the chemical dispenser. At this time, disconnect the splitter and only connect the chemical dispenser when using the mop sink. Keep the water off and dispenser disconnected when not in use.
